backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor for the BlockVerse backend, managing user profiles (avatar, login streak, power-ups, game mode preference) and daily missions with role-based access control and blob storage mixins.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report confirming the addition of an app-ads.txt file to frontend/public/ for AdMob publisher verification.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON-formatted summaries of all frontend source files, describing the purpose and key details of each component, hook, context, and utility in the project.
frontend/index.html: Root HTML entry point for the BlockVerse React app, mounting the app into a div#root and loading the main TypeScript module.
frontend/public/app-ads.txt: AdMob app-ads.txt file containing the Google publisher verification line for pub-7936595519986908 to authorize direct ad serving.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component handling authentication state, game mode selection flow, and initializing AdSense or mobile ads (with a one-time App Open ad) at startup.
frontend/src/components/ads/BannerAd.tsx: Renders a Google AdSense banner ad unit inside a theme-styled container, initializing the ad push with a short delay on mount.
frontend/src/components/ads/Interstitial: Shows a dialog-based interstitial ad when triggered, auto-closing after 5 seconds and respecting frequency capping via shouldShowAd.
frontend/src/components/ads/MobileBanner: Renders a native mobile banner ad on Capacitor/native platforms or falls back to the web BannerAd component on non-mobile environments.
frontend/src/components/ads/MobileInters: Shows a native mobile interstitial ad on native platforms when triggered, or falls back to the web InterstitialAdTrigger component otherwise.
frontend/src/components/ads/MobileNative: Renders a native ad for mobile environments using the mobile ads library, or falls back to the web NativeAd component on non-mobile platforms. Applies theme-based styling to the ad container.
frontend/src/components/ads/MobileReward: Displays a rewarded ad button for native mobile environments that shows a loading dialog and grants a random power-up upon ad completion. Falls back to the web RewardedAdButton on non-mobile platforms.
frontend/src/components/ads/NativeAd.tsx: Renders a Google AdSense native/fluid ad unit with theme-aware container styling. Initializes the ad on mount using pushAd and tracks the impression event.
frontend/src/components/ads/RewardedAdBu: Displays a button that simulates a rewarded ad flow with a loading dialog, then grants a random power-up to the user after a timed sequence. Supports light, dark, and neon themes.
frontend/src/components/AdvancedStrategy: UI component that displays theme-aware warning banners for falling block alerts and active power-up chains in Advanced Strategy Mode.
frontend/src/components/BlockPicker.tsx: Renders a horizontal row of selectable block shape buttons with theme-aware styling, responsive cell sizing, and mobile-optimized single-row layout.
frontend/src/components/DailyMissionsBut: Floating action button that opens the daily missions modal and displays a pulsing badge with the count of completed but unclaimed missions.
frontend/src/components/DailyMissionsMod: Modal component that displays daily missions for a player, showing progress bars and allowing users to claim rewards (points, power-ups, or combo boosts) for completed missions.
frontend/src/components/DailyRewardModal: Modal component that checks and presents a daily login reward (points, power-up, or combo) with streak-based multipliers, storing claim state in localStorage.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Simple themed footer component that renders a styled footer bar with theme-specific CSS classes; its content section is currently empty.
frontend/src/components/GameBoard.tsx: Interactive game board component that handles block placement, hover previews, power-up actions (block/column/row break), and moving obstacles for the advanced strategy game mode.
frontend/src/components/GameOver.tsx: Game over screen component that displays the player's final score, best score, a new-record indicator, and a restart button with theme-aware styling.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: App header component displaying the BlockVerse logo, an offline mode badge, and action buttons for home navigation, daily missions, profile, and game restart.
frontend/src/components/HomeButton.tsx: Small reusable button component that navigates the user to the home screen with a theme-styled Home icon and plays a click sound.
frontend/src/components/LanguageSelector: A fixed bottom-left dropdown button that lets users switch the app language among 10 supported locales, with styling that adapts to the current theme (light/dark/neon).
frontend/src/components/Leaderboard.tsx: A modal dialog that fetches and displays the leaderboard for a given game mode, highlighting the current user's row and showing rank badges, level badges, and an inline mobile ad.
frontend/src/components/LeaderboardButto: A fixed bottom-right circular button that opens the leaderboard, styled per the active theme.
A full-screen overlay animation shown for 3 seconds when the player levels up, displaying a celebration image, trophy icons, and the new level number before calling onComplete.
frontend/src/components/ParticleEffect.t: Renders a physics-based particle animation (line clear, level up, or combo) using image sprites positioned absolutely, updating at ~60fps until all particles fade out.
frontend/src/components/PowerUpBar.tsx: Displays the player's available power-ups as icon buttons, handles consuming them during gameplay, and prompts a rewarded-ad dialog to refill when a power-up is empty.
frontend/src/components/ScoreDisplay.tsx: Displays the current score, best score, and a temporary combo animation banner, with styling variations for light, dark, and neon themes.
frontend/src/components/SoundToggle.tsx: A fixed floating button that toggles game sound on/off, persisting the preference and resuming the audio context when sound is enabled.
frontend/src/components/ThemeSelector.ts: A fixed floating dropdown button that lets the user switch between light, dark, and neon themes, with theme-aware styling for the trigger and menu items.
frontend/src/components/TimerDisplay.tsx: Shows a countdown timer in MM:SS format, switching to a pulsing red style when 30 seconds or fewer remain.
frontend/src/components/UserProfile.tsx: A modal overlay displaying the logged-in user's profile info with logout and close actions, styled according to the current theme.
frontend/src/contexts/LanguageContext.ts: Provides a React context for multi-language support across 10 languages, persisting the selected language to localStorage and setting RTL direction for Arabic. Exposes a translation function t() keyed by string identifiers.
frontend/src/contexts/OfflineModeContext: Provides a React context that tracks online/offline network status and manages a pending sync flag in localStorage. Automatically triggers data sync when the app comes back online.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and caches an ICP backend actor using React Query, supporting both anonymous and authenticated (Internet Identity) access. Invalidates and refetches dependent queries whenever the actor instance changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements an Internet Identity authentication context and provider using DFINITY's AuthClient, exposing login/logout functions and status flags. Persists identity across page reloads and disables default idle logout behavior.
frontend/src/hooks/useNetworkStatus.ts: A simple hook that tracks the browser's online/offline status by listening to window online and offline events.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: An intentionally empty placeholder file indicating that no backend queries are needed since all game state is managed locally.
frontend/src/index.css: Global CSS file that imports Tailwind directives and defines CSS custom properties for three themes (light, dark, neon) using the OKLCH color system, plus keyframe animations for startup screen effects.
frontend/src/lib/ads.ts: Google AdSense integration module that provides configuration IDs, script initialization, ad display, event tracking, and frequency-capping utilities for a web-based ad system.
frontend/src/lib/blockShapes.ts: Defines all block shapes as 2D arrays organized by complexity levels 1–10, with a complexity map and a level-system-aware function to filter available shapes based on the current game level.
frontend/src/lib/dailyMissions.ts: Manages daily mission generation, persistence, progress tracking, and reward claiming using localStorage, with missions scaling in difficulty based on the player's level and resetting every 24 hours.
frontend/src/lib/gameLogic.ts: Core game logic utilities for block placement validation, placing blocks onto the board, clearing completed rows/columns, calculating scores, and detecting game-over conditions.
frontend/src/lib/leaderboard.ts: Handles localStorage-based leaderboard storage per game mode, player level/power-up progress, monthly leaderboard resets with top-player rewards, and score-to-level conversion.
frontend/src/lib/levelSystem.ts: Defines level configuration types and exports LEVEL_CONFIGS, a map of level numbers to settings including background images, block color palettes, difficulty parameters, visual effects, and score thresholds for a multi-level progression system.
frontend/src/lib/mobileAds.ts: Provides a bridge between the web frontend and native Google Mobile Ads (via Capacitor/Android WebView), with functions to initialize ads, show app-open ads (24-hour frequency limit), banner ads, interstitial ads (every third game), and rewarded ads.
frontend/src/lib/sounds.ts: Implements game sound effects using the Web Audio API, including block placement, line clears, combos, and game-over sounds, with toggleable sound preferences persisted to localStorage.
frontend/src/lib/userAuth.ts: Handles user authentication via locally generated unique codes, with functions to create, save, retrieve, and clear user data in localStorage, plus initialization of starter power-ups for new users.
frontend/src/locales/ar.json: Arabic (العربية) localization strings for all UI elements of the BlockVerse game, including authentication, game modes, leaderboard, power-ups, and profile screens.
frontend/src/locales/de.json: German (Deutsch) localization strings for all UI elements of the BlockVerse game, including authentication, game modes, leaderboard, power-ups, and profile screens.
frontend/src/locales/en.json: English i18n strings for the BlockVerse app, covering UI labels for auth, game modes, scoring, power-ups, leaderboard, themes, and more.
frontend/src/locales/es.json: Spanish translations of all BlockVerse UI strings, mirroring the same keys as the English locale file.
frontend/src/locales/fr.json: French translations of all BlockVerse UI strings, mirroring the same keys as the English locale file.
frontend/src/locales/ja.json: Japanese translations of all BlockVerse UI strings, mirroring the same keys as the English locale file.
frontend/src/locales/pt.json: Portuguese translations of all BlockVerse UI strings, mirroring the same keys as the English locale file.
frontend/src/locales/ru.json: Russian (Русский) localization strings for the BlockVerse game, covering UI labels, auth flows, game modes, power-ups, leaderboard, and daily rewards.
frontend/src/locales/tr.json: Turkish (Türkçe) localization strings for BlockVerse, covering the same set of UI, auth, game mode, power-up, and leaderboard keys as other locale files.
frontend/src/locales/zh.json: Simplified Chinese (简体中文) localization strings for BlockVerse, providing translations for all UI, auth, game modes, power-ups, leaderboard, and daily reward keys.
frontend/src/main.tsx: React application entry point that mounts the app with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider wrappers around the root App component.
frontend/src/pages/Game.tsx: Main game page component that manages the full game state (board, score, blocks, power-ups, level transitions, ads, daily missions) and renders all game UI components for the selected game mode.
frontend/src/pages/ModeSelection.tsx: Game mode selection page that displays themed cards for each available game mode (Time Attack, Endless, Strategy, Power Boost, Advanced Strategy) and triggers mode selection with sound effects.
frontend/src/pages/StartupScreen.tsx: Renders the initial startup/login screen with register and login modes, theme-aware styling, language/theme/sound selectors, and a mobile banner ad. Handles user code generation, audio context initialization, and calls onLogin callback after successful authentication.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides utility functions for extracting URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routing, persisting them in sessionStorage, and cleaning sensitive params from the URL hash without page reload.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining OKLCH-based design tokens (colors, border radius, shadows), custom breakpoints, accordion keyframe animations, and enabling the typography, container-queries, and animate plugins.
project_state.json: Comprehensive project state document describing BlockVerse's architecture, feature set, known bugs, and design decisions including local-first storage, ad integration, i18n, game modes, and the partially-integrated ICP/Motoko backend.
